function_signature: def pbkdf2_hmac_sha256(password, salt, iterations, dklen) -> bytes
expected_pass_rate: >= 0.85 (16 test cases in all; the main metric is task_success, scored 0 or 1 for the whole task: it is 1 only if no blocking failure occurs and every functional case passes — the registered process and performance cases are excluded from the functional set but block on failure; the pass-rate threshold on the left and the per-case pass rate are recorded as diagnostics only)
constraints: Implement PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 yourself (RFC 8018); hashlib.pbkdf2_hmac is banned; hmac+hashlib may be used; iterations≥1 / dklen≥1 / password-salt being bytes, or ValueError; deterministic, returning dklen bytes
